_doc: Configuration of scripts/contract-check. Nothing here names a source file: row types are found by their TypeScript name wherever they are declared. Since R2 (generated types in lib/database.types.ts, row types written as Pick<Tables<"x">, ...>) a row type is listed here only when it narrows a column the generated type cannot narrow: text columns with a CHECK constraint (paid_by, direction, reason_category, note_type, media_kind, audience, status of profiles) and the attendance mark with the UI-only 'pending'. Their literal unions are compared with the CHECK constraint. rpcShapes compare the keys of a function's JSON answer, which the generated types cannot see (Json).
_unresolved: Calls the extractor cannot read: 4 storage buckets that come from data (a bucket column or a function parameter fed by a table column, partly checked against every value the bucket columns allow) and the resources list, whose filters are applied by a generic helper from a plan object. A new one means a call the check no longer sees.
